comments.author: Morlan
comments.body: This Pumpkin-head was given away around 2012-13 as a reward for some event that I can't recall right now. It's sitting on my head for a long time.. I think it's stuck!

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
You wear it well, at least. Strangely, this was given out as an event reward for Halloween 2013 in Japan's servers:

gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?LiveEvent/Halloween2013

... but when we got that event in GAMA, they switched the purple Pumpkin-head out for the green one, and changed out a pair of Cat Ears for green +1 Jewel trading Wizard Clothes (which later got updated into Sorcerer's Clothes and had +2 Astronomy/Archaeology/Theology instead). Go figure.
